description: Owned by this repo, not vendored from kit -- org-specific. Shared shape for window.GAME_FRANCHISES (site/data/games.js), window.MOVIE_FRANCHISES (site/data/movies.js), and window.BOOK_FRANCHISES (site/data/books.js) -- all three are the same array-of-franchise shape, just rendered into a different card list. `href` omitted renders an unlinked placeholder card.

href.description: Link to that franchise's own Vertex Order list. Omit for a placeholder entry with no list yet.

firstPublished.description: Year. Shown after `by` ("by <by> · <firstPublished>") -- only rendered when `by` is also set.
